issues.where: crop V, with similar marks in U and S
issues.what: Numerous soft oblong smudges sit over the sharp star points. Several share almost the same diagonal shape and look like repeated foreground stamps rather than part of the sky.
issues.fix: Remove the repeated streaks or replace them with fainter, individually shaped diffuse objects that blend into the surrounding sky.

issues.where: crops W and X, bright galactic band at the lower right of the frame
issues.what: Fine stars and mottled dust smear together into short diagonal dashes, while nearby isolated points remain sharp. The bright patch looks stretched at native size.
issues.fix: Use a sharper sky texture in this area and correct the local stretch so the small stars resolve as points.

issues.where: crop M, just inside the lower edge of the solar disk
issues.what: A thin pale arc runs inside the true limb, creating a doubled contour across the solar texture.
issues.fix: Blend out the inner arc and preserve a single bright falloff at the limb without flattening the photosphere detail.

issues.where: dark sky left of the band, e.g. around x350 y555 and x125 y355 (crop D of image-10 at about 180,490)
issues.what: soft grey oval smudges sit in the empty sky; at native size they read as blurred stamps or dust on the lens rather than distant galaxies, and they have no internal structure
issues.fix: remove the smudges or swap them for small, sharp galaxy sprites with a bright core and realistic size, and use far fewer of them

issues.where: right half of the sky, e.g. around x1160 y50, x1140 y395, x720 y590, x700 y690 (crops A, C, P, Q, U of images 14-16)
issues.what: short grey dashes and faint elongated blobs are scattered over the star field; they look like motion-smeared or stretched sprites and give away a procedural layer
issues.fix: drop the streak/galaxy sprite layer or render it with sharp edges and no directional smear; keep its opacity low

issues.where: left edge of the Milky Way band, from about x700 top to x680 bottom (crops A, G, H of image-10)
issues.what: the band starts along a fairly straight near-vertical edge with a sudden jump in star density, which reads as a mask edge rather than a soft galactic falloff
issues.fix: feather the band mask more widely and break up the edge with noise so the dust and star density fade gradually

issues.where: crop U (912,866) and crop P of image-11, the bright core of the band
issues.what: brighter stars in the dense regions are soft round discs of similar size that merge into a mottled, slightly airbrushed dust layer
issues.fix: sharpen the star point-spread function and vary star sizes; add finer detail to the dust lanes

issues.where: bright star at lower left, about x150 y730 (crop S of image-16)
issues.what: the cross-shaped diffraction spike star looks pasted on and does not match the spikeless rendering of every other star
issues.fix: either give all bright stars consistent spikes or remove the spikes from this one

issues.where: Milky Way band across lower two-thirds (crops D-I in image-22.png, O-R in image-23.png, S-X in image-24.png)
issues.what: the galactic background is an undersampled, blurry skybox texture that breaks into blocky, noisy mush at native size, with baked-in stars stretched into bloated 4-10 px oval blobs directly beneath crisp 1 px procedural overlay stars
issues.fix: replace the low-resolution skybox panorama with a native-resolution star-cloud/dust map free of bloated baked-in star blobs, or render galactic dust volumetrically/procedurally so star sharpness matches across a single star population without projection stretching

issues.where: rocky moonlet/asteroid in upper right (crops C, H, I in image-18.png and L in image-19.png)
issues.what: the lit surface is soft, airbrushed, and diagonally stretched/smeared at native resolution, while the lower-left lit limb has faceted low-poly straight segments with stair-stepped pixel aliasing
issues.fix: subdivide the asteroid mesh for a smooth organic silhouette, use higher-resolution triplanar or non-stretched displacement/normal/albedo maps with crisp regolith and crater-rim micro-detail, and properly anti-alias the bright limb

issues.where: lower-left-center diagonal streak (crop G in image-18.png, crop O in image-19.png)
issues.what: a large semi-transparent brown streak displays parallel linear stripes with sharp background stars shining straight through it, reading as an artificial smeared billboard or broken motion-blur pass
issues.fix: render passing foreground debris with physically consistent multi-sample 3D motion blur and proper occlusion/exposure weighting, or remove close-camera streaking debris if shutter blur cannot be sampled cleanly

issues.where: upper dark sky in both scenes (crop L top-center and bottom-center in image-23.png; crops A, B in image-22.png; crops E, G, P in image-18.png and image-19.png)
issues.what: faint translucent grey oval blobs (35-50 px out-of-focus dust sprites in image-21.png) and dozens of small blurry grey/brown pill-shaped smudges (in image-17.png) float over crisp stars like low-res particle billboards
issues.fix: remove the out-of-focus foreground dust particle sprites or render fine debris with physically accurate sub-pixel sizing and clean depth-of-field/motion-blur sampling

issues.where: dark sky upper-right of the asteroid and right edge (crop I upper-right in image-18.png, crop M in image-19.png)
issues.what: faint patches of the underlying skybox show up as gritty, blocky orange-red pixel speckles and chroma noise against black space
issues.fix: clean or denoise faint background skybox channels and render dark-sky nebula tinting at higher bit depth and native texel density

issues.where: brightest star at lower right of image-17.png (crop E bottom-left in image-18.png, crop U right in image-20.png) and upper center of image-21.png (crop L mid-left in image-23.png)
issues.what: the bright star glare has a single-axis horizontal-only pixel spike with visible stair-stepping and no matching optical PSF symmetry
issues.fix: use a clean, radially symmetric or physically derived aperture diffraction PSF with smooth sub-pixel anti-aliasing

issues.where: dark sky above the galactic band; clearest in the upper-right tile of image-31.png and in image-30.png tiles A, C, D, H, and I
issues.what: short grey pill-shaped streaks share one tilt and read as ghosts, not stars
issues.fix: remove the streak ghosts and leave faint stars as round points

issues.where: tile W, upper middle of the dark crop
issues.what: a bluish pair of capsule smudges, with fainter streaks of the same kind in the other dark crops of image-25.png
issues.fix: clear the same streak ghosts from the darker sky

issues.where: tiles V and W, the bright band along the bottom of image-29.png
issues.what: medium stars are soft vertical ovals, and the brightest dust is mushy rather than filamentary
issues.fix: restore round star cores and break the smoothed clumps into finer dust

issues.where: inside the upper-left globe silhouette (crop B in image-34.png; crops J and K in image-35.png)
issues.what: Several isolated soft points show through the near-black disk and read as ghost stars on an otherwise opaque silhouette.
issues.fix: Use an opaque holdout for the globe before adding the background and bloom, then check that any genuine foreground light is visually distinct.

issues.where: bright right-facing limb of the planet at left (crop B in image-38.png; crops J and O in image-39.png)
issues.what: A thin bright contour and a broader cyan glow trace the same arc, giving the limb a doubled, outlined look.
issues.fix: Blend the bright contour into a single continuous atmospheric falloff while preserving the hard occultation edge of the solid globe.

issues.where: crops J and O, narrow cloud strip just inside the lit limb
issues.what: The clouds break into similarly hooked, smeared wisps that line up along the rim, making the strip look pasted on.
issues.fix: Vary cloud scale and shape, and taper cloud opacity and contrast through the terminator instead of confining the forms to a narrow arc.

issues.where: crops S and V, brightest blue-white stars
issues.what: Several stars look like soft circular blobs next to the much sharper surrounding field.
issues.fix: Keep compact stellar cores and reduce the radius of the glow on the brighter points.
